The newest section, 'August 2026', holds 16 aerial photographs whose operator file names all begin with the date 2026-08-27 and describe the construction site ('dataR_Baustelle-von-oben', for example Front-2, Blickrichtung Nord, Ost and Sued-Rueckseite, Rueckseite-auf-Kransicht, Zufahrt-TG). Two of them were captured and viewed (supporting_captures): they show the data-centre building with rooftop cooling units and exhaust stacks in place while a tower crane, site cabins and site fencing are still on the plot, i.e. a construction site that is not yet handed over. Every earlier section uses the same file-name convention with dates inside its month (for example 2026-07-02 and 2026-07-20 under 'Juli 2026', 2026-06-19 under 'Juni 2026'); the 'September 2025' and 'November 2025' headings are swapped relative to their file dates (2025-11-22 and 2025-09-01), an operator labelling slip that does not affect the 2026 sections.
